title: OpenAI revenue run rate reportedly tops $40bn ahead of expected listing
excerpt: OpenAI (Unlisted:OPAI) is on track to generate annualised revenue of more than $40 billion, according to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, r...
content_html:
Proactive

Fri, August 14, 2026 at 1:40 AM CDT 1 min read

OpenAI (Unlisted:OPAI) is on track to generate annualised revenue of more than $40 billion, according to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, roughly double its run rate at the end of 2025.

The acceleration strengthens the case for a stock market debut, with the ChatGPT maker having filed confidential paperwork to go public.

Growth has been driven in part by its AI coding software, alongside subscription sales, a young advertising business and a still-expanding consumer arm.

Greg Brockman, co-founder and president, told staff the run rate rose more than 20% month-on-month in July.

Chief financial officer Sarah Friar had previously said the company ended last year above $20 billion.

Rival Anthropic said in May its own run-rate revenue had passed $47 billion, though the two may not calculate the figure the same way.

Anthropic is expected to list as soon as this autumn, ahead of OpenAI.

Demand has picked up sharply for OpenAI's agents, including Codex and ChatGPT Work.

The company has cut prices on some models to compete with Anthropic and Chinese rivals.

On Thursday, it appointed a cybersecurity executive as chief revenue officer, its second in under a year.

content_html_zh:
积极主动的

2026 年 8 月 14 日星期五，美国中部时间 (CDT) 凌晨 1:40 阅读 1 分钟

据彭博社援引知情人士的消息称，OpenAI（未上市：OPAI）的年收入有望超过 400 亿美元，到 2025 年底大约是其运行率的两倍。

随着 ChatGPT 制造商已提交上市机密文件，这种加速增强了上市的可能性。

其增长在一定程度上是由其人工智能编码软件、订阅销售、年轻的广告业务和仍在扩张的消费者部门推动的。

联合创始人兼总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 告诉员工，7 月份的运行率环比增长了 20% 以上。

首席财务官莎拉·弗里尔 (Sarah Friar) 此前曾表示，该公司去年的营收超过 200 亿美元。

其竞争对手 Anthropic 在 5 月份表示，其运营收入已超过 470 亿美元，尽管两家公司计算该数字的方式可能有所不同。

Anthropic 预计最早于今年秋季上市，领先于 OpenAI。

对 OpenAI 代理的需求急剧增加，包括 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work。

该公司已经降低了一些型号的价格，以与 Anthropic 和中国的竞争对手竞争。

周四，该公司任命一名网络安全高管为首席营收官，这是一年内的第二次任命。
